meanings: Enno: a name (of Enrella, the pair sealed on II.3's morning); names are names (no sense given)
derivation: a name: names are names (orrowen_v2 §4.6); the Book's own spelling, with no Hal form given; unit S04 (II.3)

meanings: Della: a name (of Enrella); names are names (no sense given)
derivation: a name: names are names (orrowen_v2 §4.6); a woman's cradle-name in -a, as Bena, Denna, Rhyna; no Hal form given; unit S04 (II.3)

meanings: Enrella: the pair-name of Enno and Della, sealed at the Keep in the first high summer of the siege
derivation: the pair-name rule (orrowen_v2 §3.10): En- (Enno) + softened Dell- (d > r) + the lintel -a, as Idrenna (Id- + S·Denn- + -a); takes a dual verb; unit S04 (II.3)
nynth 'a spring; water' + S sast 'skin, a hide' (s unchanged) (compound: the head softened, §3.10), as helvnynth, crestnynth; unit S04 (II.1, 'Close behind came I with the water-skin')
a phrase: nind 'a finger' + strom 'great' (the adjective after its noun, unmutated); the lexicon has no word for the thumb; unit S04 (II.1, 'Halvard set his thumb in the bite')

meanings: (of a scribe) a quill, a pen: a feather cut for the ink
derivation: a new sense of dhenth 'a feather' (O0443): the leaf-hand's flat nib (orrowen_v2 §8) is a cut quill; Seren's pen; unit S04 (II.3, 'My pen had stopped at the cloak', 'her pen is not stopped')

meanings: hand in hand ('hand in hand': the second softened by ul, N)
derivation: a phrase: garl 'a hand' + ul 'in' (+N) + N·garl (g > n); of Enno and Della, and of the knots of Tarnel's net; unit S04 (II.3)

meanings: knot upon knot ('knot upon knot', as tolm um dholm 'stone upon stone')
derivation: a phrase: bysket 'a knot' + um 'upon' (+S) + S·bysket (b > w), built as the Cry's tolm um dholm and bystir um wystir; unit S04 (II.3, Tarnel's net)
